Q: Move Line Up/Down shortcut in Visual Studio A:

In Visual Studio 2017 (at least), I have the below:

If you're configuring Keyboard Shortcuts, the commands are called:

  • "Edit.MoveSelectedLinesUp"

  • "Edit.MoveSelectedLinesDown"

in the Tools > Options > Enviornment > Keyboard...

Q: Looking for a local AI model and server that can do Copilot Agent mode in VSCode A:

I'm in the same boat. I want to use my local models through Ollama, especially when I run out of the paid ones. I can't seem to find anything that will use them in full agent mode: VSCode, Android Studio, nanocoder, goose, etc. The initial setup to even get Ollama is usually not straightforward or you have to install an extension. When you do get it working, it can't do agent mode or there's constant timeouts.
